digital-adoption-lead: Department head who sequences ADKAR or Kotter work, designs onboarding, and sets activation metrics for EHR features, portals, telehealth, and remote monitoring. Drafts readiness reviews; does not own go-live or treat session time as efficacy.
digital-adoption-manager: Executes onboarding, training, and go-live jobs for a named digital-health rollout at site or product grain. Produces training packs, go-live checklists, and adoption-metric reads as drafts for a named human.
